---
title: "Intensity of selected speckle proteins after ActD"
output: html_notebook
---

Box plots of normalised intensities (FragPipe-Analyst) of selected proteins (SMN1, THRAP3, DDX42, BCLAF1, SRRM2, NOP2, BUD13, RBM17) per condition (DMSO / ActD, NuFANCI / input).

**Input:** `Normalized_matrix.csv` (FragPipe-Analyst, step 01), `experiment_annotation.tsv`.
**Output:** `Marker_gene_ActD.pdf`.


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# setwd("path/to/data")  # folder with the input tables (see header)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dendextend)
library(viridis)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggprism)
```

```{r}
Norm_Matrix = read_csv("Normalized_matrix.csv")
annotation = read_tsv("experiment_annotation.tsv")
```
```{r}
cvs_group<- Norm_Matrix %>%
      tidyr::gather("sample", "Intensity", -Gene, -ProteinID)  %>%
      dplyr::left_join(.,annotation, by="sample")
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=44}

 p <- cvs_group %>% filter(Gene == "SMN1" | Gene == "THRAP3" | Gene == "DDX42" | Gene == "BCLAF1" | Gene == "SRRM2"| Gene == "NOP2"| Gene == "BUD13"| Gene == "RBM17") %>% ggboxplot(., x = "condition", y = "Intensity",
                color = "condition", palette =c("#932191", "#487fab", "#90caf9", "#ce93d8"),
                add = "jitter") +
                facet_grid( . ~ Gene, scales = "free") +
                #theme_prism() +
                  theme(legend.position = "none",
                        aspect.ratio = 1,
                      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
                    )
 p
ggsave2("Marker_gene_ActD.pdf")

```
